title: fix(release): OOXML table/drawing repairs, truthful titles, aria + docs, hygiene
body:
## Summary

Bounded release-prep bundle: repairs the Excel "unreadable content" corruption in produced workbooks, removes pinned magnitudes from finding titles/summaries so they stay truthful under data edits, fixes the ReportViewer slide-count aria, documents the analytics boundary, and removes agent-only files per owner hygiene request.

### XLSX OOXML interop (native-Excel repair)

Two exceljs 4.4 emission defects, fixed by a post-`writeBuffer` zip pass in `packages/export-xlsx/src/workbook.ts` (`repairWorkbookXml`, jszip 3.10.2):

- **Collapsed table refs:** exceljs derives `tableN.xml`'s `ref`/`autoFilter` from the `addTable({rows})` argument, not from `addRow`-written cells — producing `A1:B0`/`headerRowCount="0"` (Methodology) and `A1:N1` against 2,400 rows (CleanData). Excel removes those tables. The pass rewrites every table part to the real laid-out range (`A1:N2401`, `A1:I30`, `A1:D14`, `A1:B26`).
- **Sheet element order:** exceljs emits `legacyDrawing` after `tableParts`; `CT_Worksheet` requires it before — native Excel discards sheet4 (KPI Analysis) entirely. The pass re-orders the nodes when both are present.

Verification: rebuilt EN workbook inspected at zip level (all four `tableN.xml` refs + filter refs exact; `legacyDrawing` now precedes `tableParts`); LibreOffice renders the full workbook incl. the previously-dropped sheet. A new integration test in `tests/integration/export-xlsx/workbook.test.ts` asserts all refs and the element order. **Native-Excel retest remains with the owner** — LibreOffice is an interop proxy, not proof.

### Pinned magnitudes → direction-safe copy

`finding.downtime.title` / `finding.north.title` (and the slide-3 `SAMPLE_TITLES` entry, chart `*.summary` strings, landing mirrors, contract fixtures) hardcoded derived numbers (`31.1%`, `1194→1565`, `8.0%`, `11.9%`). Under a legitimate edit — e.g. retaining duplicate source row 2411 — May downtime becomes 1209 (≈29.45%) and every pinned title becomes false. Replaced with nonnumeric, direction-safe phrasing; magnitudes remain in interpolated bodies only. New regression test retains row 2411 (action `'none'`) and pins recomputed values (May `1209`, change `≈0.294`) in `tests/unit/analysis/analysis.test.ts`. Catalog sha pins + generated i18n fixture + export-model contract fixtures updated.

### Smaller items

- `ReportViewer`: tab/tabpanel aria labels count 5 slides (workbook is a separate tab), `model.slides.length` instead of `+1`; 6-item keyboard nav preserved.
- `docs/public/status.md`: analytics now documented accurately — coarse Vercel Web Analytics pageviews on production only (origin + route label; no custom events, no spreadsheet data), and in-app hash transitions between `#/` and `#/workspace` are uncounted.
- Removed `.agents/skills/testing-rowfolio-deploy/SKILL.md`, `.devin/skills/testing-rowfolio/SKILL.md` (private copies preserved outside git), and the stale external-worker ownership notes in `docs/qa/test-harness.md` and `fixtures/hostile/README.md`.

Newly authored Arabic strings (titles + chart summaries + slide titles): **drafted — needs human review.**

## Checks

- 885 vitest pass / 94 files, `eslint`, `tsc`, `VERCEL_ENV=production pnpm build` — all clean.
- Analytics (unchanged here): verified post-PR71 on production — real beacons return 200 on `/` and `/ar`; owner dashboard confirms Visitors/Page Views ingesting.
